h:
AI最大的问题是什么？一致性......我做了一个工作流程来解决这个问题。提示不是必需的，但可以提供帮助。

原理很简单，你选择一张脸部照片（衣服/身体），一个姿势（面具将在此姿势上拍摄，因此选择一个与你的模特形状相匹配的模特）和一张背景照片。

问并享受:)

结果并不总是完美的，您可以尝试降噪等。

V2

可以支持 2 个字符，如果使用 1 个字符请确保有 FaceDetailler 绕过按钮。

有一些默认，我没有测试所有内容，接缝有头发缺陷。

o.en:
What is the biggest problem with AI? consistency... well I made a workflow that remedies this problem. Prompts are not required, but can help.

the principle is simple, you choose a photo of the face, of (clothing / body), a Pose (the mask will be taken on this pose, so choose a model that matches the shape of your model) and a background photo.

Q and enjoys :)

The result is not always perfect, you can play with the denoise and all.

V2

Can support 2 Character, if you use one character be sure to have the button FaceDetailler bypass.

There is some default, and i didn't test everything, seam to have a defect with hair.
